summary: Wire 6 deferred-scope Followers (issue #285, first batch of the 54-card BLOCKERS audit). Shared lane: touches src/L5R.Core rules engine AND src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/*.jpg (six new card-art copies from the normal content-wave pipeline, routine and non-visual-design), under Mendon's standing cross-lane authority. Asako House Guard's dual-choice Set-Force (new primitive -- the BLOCKERS note's claim of an existing SetForce pattern was not literally true, no such primitive existed; built via the established delta-to-target-value idiom, daifuke-swap-force's own shape); Legulus's Legion's bow-cost Attack reading its own live Force via sourceId (verified and proven against a token modifier, resolving the BLOCKERS note's own open question); Village Guardian's new per-player MatchState.ProvinceEverDestroyed tracker set at DestroyProvince's single choke point; Village Raiders' AttachGrantsKeyword Conqueror (its scan literally reads 'This Personality has Conqueror' despite being a Follower -- deck-pool.json's types field is authoritative) plus a flat Melee 4 Attack; Water Spider Adept's pure AttachRequiresKeyword restriction with no ability text; Yodotai Legionnaire's EntryHonorLoss carrying the real Legionnaire keyword Aulus's boost already reads. Published as content/published/follower-wave-14.json. Six BLOCKERS entries removed from build_card_inventory.py; docs/CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx regenerated (341 wired). One known, documented, out-of-scope limitation: Yodotai Legionnaire's own deck-construction permission ('you may include any number ... in your deck') is not enforced by DeckFormat.CheckLegality, which has no per-card exemption mechanism for its ordinary 3-copy soft cap -- confirmed via direct engine research that no such flag exists anywhere; this is the same pre-existing, already-documented, non-blocking gap DeckFormat.cs's own comment names ('some cards are meant to break these limits'); building a genuine exemption end-to-end would touch DeckFormat, DeckWorkshop, the client deck-builder screen and the Python content pipeline, out of scope for this batch.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 186/186 core (incl. new FollowerWave14Primitives covering all 6 cards' own new primitives), 57/57 published, 9/9 deck-format, 10/10 deck-workshop, all green. python -m unittest discover -s tools/content: 130 tests OK. python -m unittest discover -s tools/collaboration: 43 tests OK. dotnet run L5R.AI.Tests: 14/14 green. dotnet run L5R.Server.Tests: 5/5 green. dotnet run L5R.Client.Transport.Tests: 4/4 green. All 6 scans re-fetched fresh from their own receipt source_url and sha256-verified exact match; ability text hand-verified against each scan image directly. Client (Godot) build/import not run -- no client code changed, only routine published card-art copies.
remaining: None; ready for review. Next batches (Strategies, Personalities, a Region, a Ring, a Spell) from the same 54-card BLOCKERS audit are separate future tasks, one batch at a time as instructed.
